- FAB elevation appears via scale(1.02) and box-shadow on hover with 120ms ease.

Accessibility

Match the left sidebar width and icon-based vertical navigation style. Use rounded corners on pills and search input for the modern look.

Main content grid

  1) Description (leftmost, largest column)
  2) Received (small column)
  3) Completed on (small column)

- Main content: 1 column group with 3 stacked groups — (A) header/search row, (B) title + tabs, (C) table/list (grid of rows). The table/list itself is 1 column containing rows, which logically represent 4-column cells.

Medium-level workflows

- Team operations: view who completed tasks ("Completed by"), check when tasks were received and completed, and follow up via task details or comments.
- Onboarding and cleaning: use empty-state guidance when there are no completed tasks (or incomplete tasks) and create the first task with FAB.

Higher-level purpose
- The screen is designed to let operations or product users track and manage tasks across a business workflow. It centralizes task discovery (search), filtering (Incomplete/Completed), navigation to related product areas, and quick creation of tasks. The UI supports fast triage (scan metadata), assignment, and completion tracking so users can ensure work items are addressed and recorded.
